parts.t: Cliff Drive is a neighbourhood in north-west Tsawwassen, with tree-lined streets, schools, and shops and services you can walk to. Browse Cliff Drive homes for sale below, and contact me for more information.

Cliff Drive is a neighbourhood in Tsawwassen with tree-lined streets and family homes. Tsawwassen's town centre is close by, with shops, the library, restaurants and buses. Parks and schools are nearby, and homes are a mix of detached houses and townhomes.
